source: recorded from tangled.org on 2026-10-04 by tools/forge-corpus/record.sh

value.body:
Currently, the README on the repository index page is buried below the file tree and commit log. Having to scroll down 1.5 pages doesn't seem like a good UX.

Ideally, I think we need a complete layout redesign for our repo index page, but there are a few easy fixes we can do in the meantime:

- Reduce max commit count (3~5)\
  imo 3 is enough. Github & Codeberg show only one, and honestly I haven't had any issues with that. I can still see handful of recent commits from the file tree.
- Set a max height for the file tree. Cut down long lists by default.\
  The file tree is less important than the README.
value.title: UI: make readme more accessible from repo index page.
